description: Fix PATCH merge semantics (server + CLI), add execution config flags to create/update, and wire six new CLI write subcommands (prereq, comment, feedback create, reject, stop) to existing server endpoints.

tasks.title: Server PATCH three-state raw-presence-aware merge
tasks.spec: specs/http-api/spec.md#PATCH omit-means-unchanged for all optional fields
tasks.description: Replace the UpdateIssueRequest DTO model binding in the PATCH handler (IssueRoutes.Crud.cs) with a custom BindAsync that parses the raw JSON body as JsonElement and uses TryGetProperty to detect field presence — following the established AgentDefinitionRoutes.AgentUpdateRequest.BindAsync pattern. Implement three-state merge at the grain level: absent field preserves the stored value; present-null clears (for nullable/collection fields); present-with-value replaces. This covers labels, isDraft, attachmentIds, title, body, and priority. The domain Issue.Update() method or the grain handler must support explicit 'clear' for labels (empty-map replacement) and attachmentIds (unbind all) when the field is present-null.
acceptanceCriteria: Server unit test: PATCH with raw body lacking 'labels' key preserves existing labels unchanged
Server unit test: PATCH with 'labels: null' clears the label map to empty
Server unit test: PATCH with 'labels: {"k":"v"}' replaces the label map in full
Server unit test: PATCH with raw body lacking 'isDraft' key preserves existing draft state
Server unit test: PATCH with raw body lacking 'attachmentIds' key preserves existing attachment bindings
Server unit test: PATCH with only 'labels' in the body leaves title, body, priority, isDraft, attachmentIds unchanged
Server regression test: PATCH with Model/StageModels/StageModelVariants persists via the workflow profile path (verify existing behavior is not broken)
dotnet build Mohist.sln succeeds with zero warnings (TreatWarningsAsErrors)
npm test (server tests) passes
tasks.output: Modified IssueRoutes.Crud.cs PATCH handler with BindAsync, updated grain/domain merge logic, and new server unit tests
tasks.notes: Follow AgentDefinitionRoutes.cs:134-159 BindAsync pattern. If design O1 reveals that model metadata (Model/StageModels/WorkflowProfileId) is not currently wired from CreateIssueRequest/UpdateIssueRequest to the grain, include the wiring fix here since it is the same PATCH/POST handler code path.

tasks.title: CLI update sends only explicitly-provided fields in PATCH body
tasks.spec: specs/cli-interface/spec.md#CLI issue update omits unchanged optional fields from PATCH body
tasks.description: Rewrite the BuildUpdate method in MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs to construct the PATCH request body as a Dictionary<string, object?> that only includes keys for flags the user explicitly provided. When --label is not passed, the 'labels' key is omitted entirely (not sent as null). When --title, --body, --priority, or draft flags are not passed, their keys are omitted. The existing label-merge logic (fetch current labels, apply LabelDelta) is preserved when --label IS provided. This replaces the current static anonymous object that always includes every field key.
acceptanceCriteria: mo issue update <num> --body-file <f> (without --label) preserves the issue's existing labels after update
mo issue update <num> --label x --label y only sends labels in the PATCH body; title/body/priority keys are absent from the request
mo issue update <num> with no optional flags sends a PATCH with no optional field keys; the issue remains unchanged
CLI integration test: update body without --label preserves labels
CLI integration test: update labels without --title/--body preserves title and body
CLI integration test: update with conflicting body sources (--body and --body-file) exits with code 1
dotnet build Mohist.sln succeeds with zero warnings
npm test -w packages/cli (CLI tests) passes
tasks.output: Modified MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs BuildUpdate with dynamic PATCH body construction and CLI integration tests
tasks.notes: The server PATCH handler from T-001 must be in place so that omitting a field key means 'preserve'. Without T-001, the old server treats absent and null identically (both as skip), so the end-to-end contract is only fully correct after both are deployed.

tasks.title: CLI create/update execution config flags (--repository, --stage-models, --stage-model-variants)
tasks.spec: specs/cli-interface/spec.md#CLI issue create accepts execution configuration flags
tasks.description: Add --repository, --stage-models <json|@file>, and --stage-model-variants <json|@file> options to BuildCreate. Add --stage-models and --stage-model-variants to BuildUpdate (reject --repository on update with a clear error). Implement a small JSON-or-@file resolver helper (alongside BodyInputResolver) that reads a file when the value starts with '@' and parses it as JSON, returning the deserialized object. Include these fields in the create/update request body when provided. Stage-models and stage-model-variants support both inline JSON and @file syntax.
acceptanceCriteria: mo issue create <title> --repository <name> creates the issue in the specified repository
mo issue create <title> --stage-models '{"plan":"anthropic/claude-sonnet"}' sends stageModels in the create body; mo issue show reflects the configuration
mo issue create <title> --stage-models @models.json reads the file and sends parsed JSON as stageModels
mo issue create <title> --stage-model-variants @variants.json reads the file and sends parsed JSON as stageModelVariants
mo issue create <title> --stage-models 'not-json' prints a clear validation error and exits with code 1
mo issue update <num> --stage-models '{"plan":"openai/gpt-5"}' persists and is visible via mo issue show
mo issue update <num> --repository <name> prints a clear error explaining repository is immutable and exits non-zero
CLI integration test: create with stage-models from file succeeds
CLI integration test: update rejects --repository flag
dotnet build Mohist.sln succeeds with zero warnings
tasks.output: Modified BuildCreate and BuildUpdate in MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs with new flags, new JSON-or-@file resolver helper, and CLI integration tests
tasks.notes: T-002 restructures BuildUpdate to use a dynamic dictionary; this task adds stage-models flags to that new structure. If design O1 found that the server does not persist model metadata, the server-side wiring fix should have been included in T-001; verify the flags work end-to-end before closing this task.

tasks.title: CLI prereq add/remove subcommands
tasks.spec: specs/cli-interface/spec.md#CLI provides mo issue prereq subcommands
tasks.description: Add a 'prereq' command group to the issue command tree with 'add' and 'remove' subcommands. 'prereq add <number> <prereq-number>' sends POST /{number}/prerequisites with {prerequisiteNumber: N}. 'prereq remove <number> <prereq-number>' sends DELETE /{number}/prerequisites/{prereqNumber}. Both accept --project/--project-id and -o table|json. Add a PrintDeleteAsync helper to MohistCliApi following the PrintPostAsync pattern. Surface server error messages (circular dependency, nonexistent issue) without silent success.
acceptanceCriteria: mo issue prereq add <num> <prereq-num> sends POST and the prerequisite appears in mo issue show <num> prerequisites
mo issue prereq remove <num> <prereq-num> sends DELETE and the prerequisite is removed from mo issue show <num>
mo issue prereq add <num> <prereq-num> where prereq would create a cycle surfaces the server error message and exits non-zero
mo issue prereq add <num> 9999 (nonexistent) surfaces the server error and does not report silent success
mo issue prereq --help lists 'add' and 'remove' subcommands
Both subcommands accept --project/--project-id and -o table|json
CLI integration test: prereq add success and circular-dependency failure paths
CLI integration test: prereq remove success path
dotnet build Mohist.sln succeeds with zero warnings
tasks.output: New BuildPrereq command group in MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs, PrintDeleteAsync helper in MohistCliApi.cs, and CLI integration tests
tasks.notes: The DELETE endpoint already exists at IssueRoutes.Prerequisites.cs:32-48. Add PrintDeleteAsync to MohistCliApi.cs following the PrintPostAsync/PrintPatchAsync pattern.

tasks.title: CLI comment add and feedback create subcommands
tasks.spec: specs/cli-interface/spec.md#CLI provides mo issue comment add subcommand
tasks.description: Add a 'comment' command group with an 'add' subcommand: 'comment add <number> --body <text> [--body-file <f>]' sends POST /{number}/comments. Extend the existing 'feedback' command group (currently list/show) with a 'create' subcommand: 'feedback create <number> --stage <stage> --body <text> [--body-file <f>]' sends POST /{number}/feedback. Both reuse BodyInputResolver for --body/--body-file. Both accept --project/--project-id and -o table|json. Validate required flags (--body for comment, --stage and --body for feedback) before sending the request.
acceptanceCriteria: mo issue comment add <num> --body 'text' creates a comment via POST /{num}/comments and prints the new comment id
mo issue comment add <num> --body-file comment.md reads the file and sends its contents as the comment body
mo issue comment add <num> (without --body or --body-file) prints a validation error and exits with code 1
mo issue comment --help lists 'add' as a subcommand
mo issue feedback create <num> --stage plan --body 'text' creates a feedback record; mo issue feedback list <num> returns a list containing it
mo issue feedback create <num> --stage build --body-file feedback.md reads the file as the feedback body
mo issue feedback create <num> --body 'text' (without --stage) prints a validation error and exits with code 1
mo issue feedback create <num> --stage plan (without --body) prints a validation error and exits with code 1
mo issue feedback --help lists 'create' alongside 'list' and 'show'
Both commands accept --project/--project-id and -o table|json
CLI integration test: comment add success and missing-body failure paths
CLI integration test: feedback create success and missing-stage failure paths
dotnet build Mohist.sln succeeds with zero warnings
tasks.output: New BuildComment command group and BuildFeedbackCreate subcommand in MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs, plus CLI integration tests
tasks.notes: The comment endpoint exists at IssueRoutes.Lifecycle.cs:62-89 (AddCommentRequest with Body + optional AttachmentIds). The feedback endpoint exists at IssueRoutes.Feedback.cs:13-42 (CreateFeedbackRequest with Stage + Body). Reuse BodyInputResolver for body resolution.

tasks.title: CLI reject and stop actions
tasks.spec: specs/cli-interface/spec.md#CLI provides mo issue reject command
tasks.description: Add 'reject <number> --message <text>' that sends POST /{number}/reject with {message: 'text'}. Add 'stop <number>' that sends POST /{number}/stop. The reject command requires --message; missing it prints a validation error and exits 1. The stop --help text must explain that stop is terminal (cannot be resumed) and distinguish it from force-stop (which pauses). Both accept --project/--project-id and -o table|json.
acceptanceCriteria: mo issue reject <num> --message 'msg' sends POST /{num}/reject with the message and prints confirmation
mo issue reject <num> (without --message) prints a validation error and exits with code 1
mo issue stop <num> sends POST /{num}/stop and prints confirmation that the issue was stopped
mo issue stop --help explains that stop is terminal (cannot be resumed) and distinguishes it from force-stop (pause)
Both commands accept --project/--project-id and -o table|json
CLI integration test: reject success and missing-message failure paths
CLI integration test: stop success path
dotnet build Mohist.sln succeeds with zero warnings
tasks.output: New BuildReject and BuildStop commands in MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs, plus CLI integration tests
tasks.notes: The reject endpoint exists at IssueRoutes.WorkflowControl.cs:42-57 (RejectRequest with Message). The stop endpoint exists at IssueRoutes.WorkflowControl.cs:131-150. These follow the BuildAction pattern (line 460-486) with the addition of --message for reject.
